verdict.rationale: Online account integration is a fair axis for a desktop OS, but the evidence pack never documents syncing online calendars, contacts, or data into the Windows desktop. Community posts about converting to or being pushed toward a Microsoft account describe sign-in, not calendar or contact integration, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can bring my online calendar, contacts, and data into the desktop with online account integration
